name: Mercafé
description: Official online store of the 3 Corações group for coffee. Sells coffee capsules, coffee machines, ground and whole-bean coffees, cappuccinos, accessories and offers a subscription. Its delivery policy says deliveries cover all of Brazil and that delivery abroad and to PO boxes is not offered.
description_es: Tienda online oficial del grupo 3 Corações para café. Vende cápsulas de café, máquinas de café, cafés molidos y en grano, cappuccinos y accesorios, y ofrece suscripción. Su política de entrega indica que las entregas cubren todo Brasil y que no se realizan entregas al exterior ni a casillas postales.

ships_to.notes: Delivery policy says deliveries occur across all of Brazil; no international delivery and no PO box delivery. Risk areas defined by Correios or the carrier may have different arrangements.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Delivery policy does not mention pickup at a Mercafe location; Correios may ask the recipient to collect at an agency in some regions.
